title: Arranged According to the Laws of Chance
summary: Torn-paper squares scattered by the browser's cryptographic entropy — unseeded and unstored, so the composition can never be reproduced.
mechanism: crypto.getRandomValues() drives a per-throw canvas collage held only in RAM (no seed, no storage, no network), making the picture physically irreproducible.
references: Hans (Jean) Arp, Untitled (Collage with Squares Arranged According to the Laws of Chance), 1916-17
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
Kenneth Martin, Chance and Order / y-a-v-a, A Chance of Order (2021)
